content: Kupwurokong en lih kin wiahda oh kalinganahla imwe; ahpw me pweipwei kin kauwehla.
Ke en lelepek, ke ahpw pahn kasalehda me ke lemmwiki KAUN-O; ke en salelepek, ke ahpw pahn kasalehda me ke sohte lemmwiki.
Aklapalap en me pweipwei kin kahrehiong eh lokaia tohto; ahpw lokaiahn aramas loalokong kin sinsile pein ih.
Ma sohte kou mehn deipwelih sahpw, omw imwen nahk pahn tehn, ahpw ma mie kou, omw imwen nahk pahn kin dir ahnsou koaros.
Sounkadehde likilik men kin lokaia mehlel ahnsou koaros, ahpw me keseulikilik kin lokaia likamw ahnsou koaros.
Aramas lemei sohte kak loalokongla, ahpw aramas me loalokong kin mwadangete esehla mehkot.
Keiweisang rehn aramas pweipwei kan; sohte mehkot me re kak padahkihong uhk.
Dahme aramas loalokong kin loalokongki? Pwehki eh ese dahme e pahn wia. Dahme aramas me sohte audepe kin pweipweiki? Pwehki eh kin medemedewe me e ese mehkoaros.
Aramas pweipwei sohte kin nsenohki ma re wiahda dihp, ahpw aramas mehlel kin men ale mahkpen diparail.
Omw peren iei pein ahmw; omw nsensuwed iei pil pein ahmw. Sohte emen pahn iang ahneki omw peren de omw nsensuwed.
Imwen aramas mwahu men pahn duweduwehte mwurin imwen aramas suwed men eh pahn ohlahr.
Ahl me ke lemeleme me iei ahl en pwung, kakete kahluwaiukalahng mehla.
Kouruhr kakete karirihala nsensuwed. Ni peren eh kin sohralahr, pahtou kin mihmihte.
Aramas suwed pahn ale dahme konehng irail. Aramas mwahu pahn ale ketingpen ar wiewia kan.
Aramas pweipwei kin kamehlele mehkoaros; aramas loalokong kin kanahieng arail kahk koaros.
Aramas me mie eh lamalam kin tehk ni keneinei pwe re en dohweisang wasa me kahpwal mie, ahpw me pweipwei kin seukautih oh mwadangete lohdiong.
Aramas me kin mwadang lingeringerda kin wiahda tiahk en pweipwei; aramas loalokong kin meleilei.
Aramas pweipwei pahn ale dahme konehng ar pweipwei, ahpw me loalokong pahn ale ketingpen loalokong.
Aramas suwed pahn poaridi mwohn me pwung kan oh peki arail sawas ni karakarahk.
Sohte me kin men kompoakepahnki me semwehmwe, pil mehn mpe kan sohte kin men patehng, ahpw kompoakepahn me kepwehpwe kan kin ngeder.
Ma ke men peren, a ke kadek ong me semwehmwe kan; me kin mwamwahliki mehn mpe kin wiahda dihp.
Ma ke pahn wia doadoahk en kamwahu, ke pahn ale wahu oh likilik sang rehn aramas teikan; ma ke pahn wia me suwed, eri, ke wiadahr sapwung ehu.
Doadoahk ke ahpw pahn mour; ma ke pahn mwomwohdete wie koasoakoasoi, ke pahn semwehmwe.
Kepwehpwe kin wia ketingpen me kupwurokong kan, ahpw me pweipwei kin ndandki ar pweipwei.
Sounkadehde men kin doarehla mour ma e lokaia mehlel; ni eh kin lokaia likamw, e kin pangala mour en aramas akan.
Lemmwiki KAUN-O kin kahrehiong aramas emen oh eh peneinei ar pahn koapworopwor oh saledek sang apwal.
Ke men doarehsang uhk mehla? Lemmwiki KAUN-O iei poahsoan en mour.
Lingan en nanmwarki men kin mihmi ni uwen tohtohn aramas me e kaunda; ma sohte aramas, eri, sohte ih mehkot.
Ma ke kanengamah oh meleilei, eri, ke me loalokong, ahpw ma ke kin mwadang lingeringer, eri, ke kin kasalehda omw pweipwei.
Nan kapehd meleilei kin karosonehda paliwar, ahpw luwak kin rasehng soumwahu suwed.
Ma ke pahn kahpwalihala aramas semwehmwe, ke mwamwahliki Koht, me ketin wiairailda, ahpw tiahk en kadek ong me semwehmwe kan iei kaudok ehu.
Aramas suwed kan kin pein kahrehiong ar pwupwudi sang ni ar wiewia suwed kan, ahpw aramas mwahu kin silasilkihdi mehlel en nan kapehdirail.
Kupwurokong kin mihmi nan lamalam en aramas loalokong men; aramas pweipwei sohte mwahn ese duwen kupwurokong.
Pwung kin kahrehda wehi ehu eh pahn lapalapala; dihp kin kanamenekihala wehi.
Nanmwarki kan kin kupwurperenki sapwellimarail sounpapah koahiek kan, ahpw re kin kaloke irail kan me sohte papah irail mwahu.
